# Omarchy theme fixtures

`<theme>/colors.toml` is copied unchanged from the 22 themes bundled with Omarchy 4.0.4
(`/usr/share/omarchy/themes/`), read from a real Omarchy install. The tests use them to prove that
every Omarchy theme becomes a Polycarp theme that passes the contrast rules.

Omarchy is MIT licensed: Copyright (c) David Heinemeier Hansson, https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy.
`LICENSE` in this folder is upstream's license file, fetched from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/basecamp/omarchy/master/LICENSE on 2026-11-05 and read to confirm
it is the MIT license text. The copy of Omarchy these files came from ships no license file under
`/usr/share/omarchy`; its package metadata says only `Licenses: MIT`. These files are test data only
and are not built into the `polycarp` program.
